title: 팝! 달 기지 이발소
description: 강렬한 망점과 잉크선으로 그린 복고풍 달 기지 이발소에서 다섯 가지 차이를 찾아보세요.

On the right, a small purple service robot with one yellow five-point star emblem on its chest stands beside a cream sink. Above it, a round porthole shows one ringed planet and exactly two small cream stars. A large cyan-blue ceiling lamp hangs near the upper left. The floor is a bold cream-and-black checkerboard.
